blocks.text: SORSOGON CITY — Five people are feared dead after a fire gutted the Sorsogon City Public Market late Saturday night, Oct. 24, with authorities struggling to identify the possible victims because their remains were severely burned. “The fatalities were believed to be stall owners or bystanders, but authorities have yet to establish their identities, as Scene of the Crime Operatives are still conducting an investigation,” FO1 Vanessa Fullion, radio operator of the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) in Sorsogon City, told the Inquirer by phone.
